thread:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing SDK v2.3 release. Need status on: packaging, changelog cutoff, sample apps, and doc quickstarts. Cutoff we're targeting is Tue 11:59pm PT. Who's owning the changelog aggregation?
aj: I can own changelog aggregation. I'll collect PRs today and send the draft. Can folks drop PR numbers here by EOD?
kevin: Packaging is green for python/js SDKs. Built artifacts are on staging. Waiting on one native sample app fix (PR #412) from @sophia.
sophia: PR #412 is up, tests flaky in CI, rerunning now. If it passes, we can cut the sample app release.
oliver: Docs quickstarts — I updated the node/python quickstarts to match the new config. Need a docs review for wording and the code snippet validation.
maria: Good. @aj will you consolidate changelog entries into the format we use? Example header: 
```
## Unreleased
- feature: SDK streaming support (PR #398) — @kevin
- fix: sample app logging bug (PR #412) — @sophia
```
aj: Yep that's the template I'll use. Please prefix entries with component labels (sdk/docs/sample).
kevin: FYI there is one breaking change for `Client.connect()` -> `Client.start()` in python SDK. Need a clear migration note in the changelog + quickstart update. I'll draft the snippet.
ocs: (typo) sorry docs-bot?
docs-bot: Reminder: docs deploy window is 2am-4am UTC. Merging after that window delays publishing until next deploy.
maria: Noted. We should aim to merge content before the 2am UTC window so the site shows the changelog on release day.
sophia: CI passed for #412. Marking ready. @aj add it under sample.
aj: Added #412 under sample with short note. Also added migration note from @kevin. Draft changelog URL: /internal/release/changelogs/v2.3-draft.md
kevin: I'll post the migration snippet here for copy/paste: 
```python
# before
client = Client(url)
# after
client = Client.start(url)
```
maria: Perfect. Two outstanding items: 1) sample apps packaging (oliver to confirm), 2) doc wording review (kevin/oliver/sophia). Can we get both done by 6pm PT?
oliver: I can finish packaging by 4pm PT and open the packaging PR. Tagging @kevin for doc wording.
kevin: I'll review the quickstarts by 5:30pm PT.
release-bot: Automated check: dependency audit ok, vuln scan passed for staged artifacts.
maria: Thanks. Last ask: when you merge, please add the following footer to PRs so @release-bot picks them up: `release: v2.3 candidate`.
aj: Will do. Also pinging reviewers: @kevin @sophia @oliver please review changelog draft here: /internal/release/changelogs/v2.3-draft.md
sophia: Reviewing now, will leave one wording suggestion on migration.
kevin: Reviewed and approved quickstart wording. Left a minor nit about timeout defaults.
maria: Great — assuming merges happen before 11:59pm PT, I'll mark changelog cutoff met and trigger the release checklist tomorrow morning. If anything blocks, drop a quick note here. :thumbsup:
aj: Uploading final changelog in 30m. PR list so far: #398, #412, #421, #434.
kevin: Also note: sample app release tag will be `sample-v1.8.0` and SDK tag `redwood-sdk-v2.3-rc1`.
maria: Thanks everyone. Closing the loop — I'll post a summary in the release thread when the artifacts are tagged.
release-bot: Release checklist queued. Next action: manual approval by @maria.
maria: I'll review the checklist at 9am PT tomorrow and kick off the release.
kevin: Thanks — will be on standby for any hotfixes.
oliver: Packaging PR opened: #437.
sophia: Changelog note added for sample app under `sample` section.
aj: Final changelog pushed to draft and linked in the release docs.
maria: Awesome. End-to-end looks covered. :party_parrot:
